name: NES
title: The Cartridge Explorer's Collection
tagline: Catalogued EU-first — the console that saved the industry, from Nintendo's foundational classics to import RPGs that never crossed every border.

name: Game Boy
title: The Handheld Explorer's Collection
tagline: A decade in your pocket — puzzle boxes, SaGa-era RPGs, and the cartridge that started Pokémon.

name: Mega Drive
title: The Mega Drive Explorer's Collection
tagline: Catalogued the European way — Mega Drive branding, PAL years, and the British-and-French developer scene the usual American story skips.

name: SNES
title: The Console Explorer's Collection
tagline: Catalogued EU-first — the console most people mean by "16-bit classic," deep in every genre from Chrono Trigger to a sequel that shipped 22 years late.

name: PlayStation
title: The CD Explorer's Collection
tagline: Catalogued EU-first — the console that made the console RPG mainstream, from Crash Bandicoot to the Squaresoft imports Europe never got.

name: Nintendo 64
title: The Polygon Explorer's Collection
tagline: Catalogued EU-first — Nintendo's leap into true 3D, cartridges over discs, and the GoldenEye that proved consoles could do shooters too.

name: Game Boy Color
title: The Spectrum Explorer's Collection
tagline: Its own identity, not a Game Boy footnote — a Pokémon-driven boom, Nintendo's first color Zeldas, and a deep well of Japan-only curios.

name: PlayStation 2
title: The Disc Explorer's Collection
tagline: The biggest console library ever assembled, sampled corner to corner instead of scored top to bottom.

name: GameCube
title: The Platform Explorer's Collection
tagline: Nintendo's own landmarks sit beside the Japan-only oddities import collectors still chase.

name: Game Boy Advance
title: The Advance Explorer's Collection
tagline: 32-bit gone anywhere — the generation that made "Metroidvania" a real genre, plus the handheld Wars and Fire Emblem debuts that went global.

name: PSP
title: The Portable Explorer's Collection
tagline: Console-caliber ambition folded into a UMD case, anchored by a tactics-RPG shelf deep enough to rival any home system.

name: Wii
title: The Channel Explorer's Collection
tagline: The best-selling console of its generation, from pack-in bowling to three JRPGs a fan campaign had to save.
